extractor.note: Read every paragraph carrying transcend- (outside transcendental), immanen-, surpass, overstep or going beyond, in file order. The many uses of surpass and overstep in the ethics (goods surpassing goods, overstepping the will-realm) are not the theme. No stratum is set: the commentary's sections are not tied to the 1908/09, 1911 and 1914 courses at these places.

coverage_note: Term-led pass over the whole file (lines 1-777): every paragraph containing the transcendence family, including bare transcendent and immanent, was read; paragraphs without such a word were not read.

units.claim: Reason-appraisal of acts depends exclusively on their immanent essence, not on their being human acts within nature.
units.quote: an appraisal for which it depends exclusively on the immanent essence of the acts, on their immanent kind, and not at all on whether they are human acts

units.claim: Reflection on perception as subjective and the perceived as transcendent led to doubt whether knowledge could get beyond itself and assure itself of the being of the transcendent.
units.quote: one told oneself that perception and perceived thing are evidently different things, the one "subjective," the other "transcendent" to subjectivity; one fell into doubt whether human knowledge could get beyond itself and ever really assure itself of the being of the transcendent

units.claim: Positing something transcendent to consciousness, distinguishing correct from false knowledge and perception from illusion, are all occurrences within the consciousness-sphere.
units.quote: When, on the contrary, I posit in a consciousness something transcendent to my consciousness, an outer thing for instance, when I gain knowledge with regard to it

units.claim: The knowledge-problems were first felt as problems of nature-knowledge: how nature, transcendent to the knowledge-consciousness, can be known.
units.quote: how nature, being in itself, as something transcendent to the knowledge-consciousness, is yet to be knowable

absences.expected_because: The commentary elsewhere locates the skepticism of natural theories of knowledge in doubt about reaching the transcendent, and this section cancels logical skepticism.
